items.title: Nvidia's latest graphics card driver appears to be unnecessarily writing to PC SSDs, something that's dumb, annoying and definitely warrants reverting
items.en_title: Nvidia's latest graphics card driver appears to be unnecessarily writing to PC SSDs, something that's dumb, annoying and definitely warrants reverting
items.en_oneliner: Nvidia's latest GeForce driver 621.24 writes large amounts of data to PC SSDs for no good reason, adding needless wear — best to roll back for now.

items.title: Two Minutes a Day: Why Habit-Sized Games Keep Working
items.en_title: Two Minutes a Day: Why Habit-Sized Games Keep Working
items.en_oneliner: Daily games compete for a short, repeatable slot in a player's day, and the author uses a daily word puzzle to unpack the design trade-offs of keeping that slot deliberately finite.
